name: Depot

billing.notes: Per-minute rates, tracked per second with no one-minute minimum (pricing FAQ: "if you run a 30-second ... GitHub Actions job, you'll only be billed for 30 seconds"). Depot also shows a "minutes multiplier" per runner (billed minutes = elapsed minutes x multiplier, counted against plan minutes); its multipliers are not proportional to the listed per-minute prices for Windows, so runnerdb stores the listed per-minute prices and mentions the multiplier in runner notes. Runner specs and prices: https://depot.dev/docs/github-actions/runner-types

free_tier.notes: No free plan; 7-day trial. Developer plan ($20/month) includes 2,000 GitHub Actions minutes and Startup ($200/month) 20,000, measured at the base 2-vCPU Linux rate. Additional usage $0.006/minute for the base runner. Discounts for non-profits/open source on request. Not applied in runnerdb prices.

notes: Public and private repositories are billed alike (open-source discounts on request).
